nodes.name: Send Notification (provider placeholder)
nodes.notes: Disabled placeholder. Point COVE2E_NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER_URL at an email/SMS provider and enable this node to send for real. While disabled the composed message passes straight through.

parameters.content:
## COVE2E Notification
Builds a user-facing message from `document_types` (e.g. "Please upload: medical certificate") and returns it to the backend, which shows it in the app.

The provider HTTP node is disabled on purpose; enable it and set COVE2E_NOTIFICATION_PROVIDER_URL / _TOKEN to send via email or SMS.
